::: {#def-layer-norm}

#### Layer normalization

**Layer normalization** rescales the [pre-activation](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-pre-activation)s of a layer across the [units](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit) of one example.
For an example with pre-activations $z_1, \dots, z_L$,
it uses their mean and variance

$$
\mu = \frac{1}{L} \sumto{j}{L} z_j,
\qquad
\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{L} \sumto{j}{L} \paren{z_j - \mu}^2,
$$

and replaces each $z_j$ with $\gamma_j \paren{z_j - \mu} / \sqrt{\sigma^2 + \smallconst} + \beta_j$
[@ba2016layer].
It does the same in training and in prediction,
since it never looks at other examples.

:::
